definitions.explanation: Formal questioning or inquiry, especially in official proceedings such as parliamentary sessions, meetings, or academic presentations.

examples.japanese: {質疑|しつぎ}{応答|おうとう}の{時間|じかん}です。
examples.english: It's time for the Q&A session.

examples.japanese: {予算案|よさんあん}について{質疑|しつぎ}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: Questioning was conducted regarding the budget proposal.

examples.japanese: {発表|はっぴょう}の{後|あと}に{質疑|しつぎ}{応答|おうとう}の{時間|じかん}が{設|もう}けられているので、{質問|しつもん}があればそのときにお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: A Q&A session is scheduled after the presentation, so if you have questions, please ask then.

notes:
Compound of {質|しつ} (question) + {疑|ぎ} (doubt, inquiry). A formal word used primarily in official or institutional contexts.

USAGE:
Most commonly appears in the compound {質疑|しつぎ}{応答|おうとう} (Q&A, question and answer). Used in parliamentary proceedings ({国会|こっかい}), business meetings, academic conferences, and other formal settings. More formal than {質問|しつもん} (question).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {質疑|しつぎ}{応答|おうとう} — question and answer session, Q&A
- {質疑|しつぎ}を{行|おこな}う — to conduct questioning
- {質疑|しつぎ}{時間|じかん} — questioning period
- {質疑|しつぎ}に{答|こた}える — to respond to questions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {質問|しつもん} — question (general, everyday use)
- {尋問|じんもん} — interrogation (legal/police context, more confrontational)
- {審議|しんぎ} — deliberation (broader process of examining and discussing a matter)
